initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is -0.10, but the supplied checks establish arithmetic correctness only. Request archived design record R211-1 to assess whether the causal effect is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The design record establishes randomized assignment independent of potential outcomes, full compliance, positivity, consistency, and no interference. Thus the causal risk difference equals the observed population contrast: 8/80 − 24/120 = −0.1.
